removed.reason: Paragraph describes malicious landing pages used to spread Android implants, not credential capture via web portals.
Mentions stealing WhatsApp messages via Accessibility Services, not remote email collection from Exchange/Office 365/Google Workspace.
Connecting infected devices to attacker-controlled Wi-Fi networks is not the same as leveraging external remote services for initial access or persistence.
No specific behavior matching a known technique is described; landing-page distribution alone does not establish this unknown technique.
